photos.summary: Finished sourdough boule cooling on a wire rack, shot close-up with shallow depth of field and warm lighting. The crust shows deep golden-brown color with prominent flour dusting and a bold score that opened wide during the bake.

photos.name: img-6875
photos.summary: Dough ball resting in a large glass mixing bowl after folding, showing a smooth, slightly glossy surface with visible fold lines. Corresponds to the BULK stage.

photos.name: img-6876
photos.summary: Finished sourdough boule on a round wire cooling rack, viewed from the front. A deep score line has opened dramatically with a dark, caramelized ear, and decorative side scoring is visible on the flour-dusted crust.

photos.name: img-6877
photos.summary: Top-down angled view of the finished boule on a wire cooling rack, showing the flour-dusted crust surface with decorative score marks and small blisters across the top.
